steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The food industry encompasses all stages from farm to fork: production, processing, manufacturing, distribution, retail, and food service.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Primary production: farming (arable, pastoral, mixed), fishing, and aquaculture (fish farming).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Food manufacturing transforms raw ingredients into processed products; the UK food manufacturing sector is the largest manufacturing sector by employment.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Distribution includes transport (road, rail, sea, air), cold chain logistics (refrigerated transport and storage), and warehousing.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Use the 'farm to fork' framework when describing the food supply chain. For industry impact questions, cover economic, environmental, and social aspects. When discussing food prices, link to specific causes (e.g. 'poor harvest reduces supply, pushing prices up') rather than vague statements. Mention current trends (plant-based, online shopping, sustainability) to show up-to-date knowledge.
